name: Lahsbane
description: Lahsbane was a planet located in the Lahsbane system in the Onatos sector in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, and was situated in grid square R-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid. During his time as a Padawan of the Jedi Order, Dooku and his Jedi Master, Yoda, traveled to Lahsbane, which the Serennian later documented in his personal journal.
